parameters.jsCode:
const state = $getWorkflowStaticData('global');
return [{ json: { offset: state.telegramUpdateOffset ?? 0 } }];

parameters.query:
SELECT
  $1::bigint AS telegram_user_id,
  $2::bigint AS chat_id,
  $3::bigint AS update_id,
  $4::text AS message_text,
  $5::text AS callback_data,
  $6::text AS callback_query_id,
  c.state,
  c.draft
FROM (VALUES (1)) AS seed(value)
LEFT JOIN telegram_conversations AS c
  ON c.telegram_user_id = $1::bigint;

WITH saved AS (
  INSERT INTO ventilation_entries (
    telegram_user_id, room, ventilated_at, duration_minutes,
    ventilation_method, temperature_c, relative_humidity_percent
  )
  SELECT $1::bigint, $7::text, $8::timestamptz, $9::integer,
         $10::text, $11::numeric, $12::numeric
  WHERE $6::boolean
  RETURNING id
), conversation AS (
  INSERT INTO telegram_conversations (telegram_user_id, chat_id, state, draft, updated_at)
  SELECT $1::bigint, $2::bigint, $3::text, $4::jsonb, now()
  WHERE NOT $5::boolean AND NOT $6::boolean
  ON CONFLICT (telegram_user_id) DO UPDATE SET
    chat_id = EXCLUDED.chat_id,
    state = EXCLUDED.state,
    draft = EXCLUDED.draft,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING telegram_user_id
), deleted AS (
  DELETE FROM telegram_conversations
  WHERE telegram_user_id = $1::bigint AND ($5::boolean OR $6::boolean)
  RETURNING telegram_user_id
)
SELECT
  $2::bigint AS chat_id,
  $13::text AS reply_text,
  $14::jsonb AS reply_markup,
  $15::text AS callback_query_id,
  (SELECT id FROM saved) AS entry_id;
